title: citharexylum spinosum f. subvillosum
intro: Citharexylum spinosum f. subvillosum, commonly known as the "tree of life", is a plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The health benefits associated with Citharexylum spinosum f. subvillosum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, treating skin conditions, and preventing the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
